-- =================================================================
-- Description:	This gets a basic report for [EntregaPaqueteria] table
-- =================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_EntregaPaqueteria_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@Paqueteria_Id AS INT = 0, 
@Suscriptor_Id AS INT = 0, 
@Usuario_Id AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @EntregaPaqueteriaFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		EntregaPaqueteria_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @EntregaPaqueteriaFilter (EntregaPaqueteria_Id)
		SELECT 
			[EntregaPaqueteria].Id
		FROM [dbo].[EntregaPaqueteria]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[EntregaPaqueteria].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @EntregaPaqueteriaFilter (EntregaPaqueteria_Id)
		SELECT 
			[EntregaPaqueteria].Id
		FROM [dbo].[EntregaPaqueteria]
		WHERE
			 (([EntregaPaqueteria].[Paqueteria_Id] = @Paqueteria_Id) OR (@Paqueteria_Id = 0)) AND
         (([EntregaPaqueteria].[Suscriptor_Id] = @Suscriptor_Id) OR (@Suscriptor_Id = 0)) AND
         (([EntregaPaqueteria].[Usuario_Id] = @Usuario_Id) OR (@Usuario_Id = 0))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[EntregaPaqueteria].[Id],
		[EntregaPaqueteria].[Paqueteria_Id],
		[EntregaPaqueteria].[Suscriptor_Id],
		[EntregaPaqueteria].[Usuario_Id],
		[EntregaPaqueteria].[FechaEntrega],
		[Suscriptor].[Nombre] + ' ' + [Suscriptor].[ApellidoPaterno] + ' ' + [Suscriptor].[ApellidoMaterno] + ' (' + [Suscriptor].[CorreoElectronico] + ')' AS [QuienRecibe],
		[Usuario].[Nombre] + ' ' + [Usuario].[ApellidoPaterno] + ' ' + [Usuario].[ApellidoMaterno] + ' (' +  [Usuario].[CorreoElectronico] + ')' AS [QuienEntrega]
	FROM @EntregaPaqueteriaFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[EntregaPaqueteria] 
			ON [EntregaPaqueteria].[Id] = filter.[EntregaPaqueteria_Id] 
			

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Paqueteria]
		ON [dbo].[EntregaPaqueteria].[Paqueteria_Id] = [dbo].[Paqueteria].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Suscriptor]
		ON [dbo].[EntregaPaqueteria].[Suscriptor_Id] = [dbo].[Suscriptor].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Usuario]
		ON [dbo].[EntregaPaqueteria].[Usuario_Id] = [dbo].[Usuario].[Id] 

 
END
-- END OF [dbo].[cgp_EntregaPaqueteria_Index]
Name: rpt_EntregaPaqueteria_Index
